source.content: compression.ZipWriter writer = new compression.ZipWriter(); System.assertEquals(compression.Level.DEFAULT_LEVEL, writer.getLevel()); System.assertEquals(compression.Method.DEFLATED, writer.getMethod()); compression.ZipEntry first = writer.addEntry('a.txt', Blob.valueOf('alpha')); System.assertEquals(first.hashCode(), first.hashCode()); writer.addEntry('b.txt', 'second file', Datetime.now(), compression.Method.STORED, Blob.valueOf('bravo')); System.assertEquals(2, writer.getEntries().size()); System.assertEquals('a.txt', writer.getEntry('a.txt').getName()); System.assertEquals(true, writer.getEntryNames().contains('b.txt')); writer.setLevel(compression.Level.BEST_SPEED); writer.setMethod(compression.Method.STORED); System.assertEquals(compression.Level.BEST_SPEED, writer.getLevel()); System.assertEquals(compression.Method.STORED, writer.getMethod()); Blob archive = writer.getArchive(); compression.ZipReader reader = new compression.ZipReader(archive); System.assertEquals(2, reader.getEntries().size()); System.assertEquals('alpha', reader.extract('a.txt').toString()); compression.ZipEntry fromReader = reader.getEntry('b.txt'); System.assertEquals('bravo', reader.extract(fromReader).toString()); System.assertEquals(true, reader.getEntriesMap().containsKey('a.txt')); System.assertEquals('a.txt', reader.getEntryNames().get(0)); compression.ZipWriter copied = new compression.ZipWriter(); copied.addEntry(fromReader); System.assertEquals('b.txt', copied.getEntry('b.txt').getName()); writer.removeEntry('a.txt'); System.assertEquals(null, writer.getEntry('a.txt')); System.assertEquals(1, writer.getEntries().size()); try { throw new compression.ZipException(); } catch (compression.ZipException ex) { System.assertEquals('compression.ZipException', ex.getTypeName()); }
